pages.text: Billions of T. rex likely roamed the Earth, paleontologists report | National Geographic Paleontologists figured out how many T. rex lived on Earth—and they found that about 20,000 would have been alive at any given time during a two- to three-million year timespan. Illustration by STOCKTREK IMAGES, Nat Geo Image Collection SCIENCE NEWS Billions of T. rex likely roamed the Earth, paleontologists report The iconic predator’s estimated abundance means the T. rex fossils we have today are exceedingly rare. By Michael Greshko Published April 19, 2021 • 6 min read If you traveled back in time 67 million years ago to ancient Montana, you’d be entering the realm of a tyrant: the iconic predator Tyrannosaurus rex . Before you venture into that lost world, though, you might want to know: On average, how close is the nearest T. rex to you? That might sound like an impossible thing to know—but after crunching through two decades’ worth of T. rex research, a new study provides estimates of the animal’s population density. In all likelihood, a T. rex would be within 15 miles of you, if not much closer. The new study, published last Thursday in Science , also translates these population densities into estimates for how many T. rex ever lived. On average, researchers estimate that some 20,000 T. rex lived at any one time and that about 127,000 generations of the dinosaurs lived and died. Those averages imply that a total of 2.5 billion T. rex lived in the species’ native North America, possibly as far north as Alaska and as far south as Mexico, over a two- to three-million-year timespan.

They are an essential part of American history and embody the strong and resilient characteristics of the American people - so much so that they were designated as our National Mammal in 2016. Once numbering ~30 million and ranging across the United States and in Canada and Mexico, bison were hunted to near extinction, with only several hundred remaining by the 1870’s. ELY, Nev. – The Bureau of Land Management began a wild horse gather Nov. 14, in and around the Antelope Complex Herd Management Area in northern Nevada, to protect the health of the herd as late season forage declines and winter approaches. The gather will help reduce the risks wild horses face when the range can no longer support the current population. The Antelope Complex includes the Antelope, Antelope Valley, Goshute, and Spruce-Pequop Herd Management Areas. Horses may appear healthy at the start of the fall, but forage and water resources are limited. Share sensitive information only on official, secure websites. https://www.nist.gov/blockchain Information technology Blockchain Sign Up to Get NIST News GovDelivery Blockchain technology provides a way for a community of participants to maintain a shared, tamper-evident, and tamper-resistant digital ledger. It is the underlying technology for many cryptocurrency systems, but it can also be used in other types of applications. A blockchain is the ledger itself. It contains transactional records that are grouped into blocks. Each block is cryptographically linked to the previous block, making the ledger tamper evident. If data in an earlier block is changed, the cryptographic link to that block changes, and the change can be detected in later blocks. As new blocks are added, older blocks become more difficult to modify, creating tamper resistance. A blockchain network is the network in which a blockchain is used. Copies of the ledger are maintained across nodes in the network, and new blocks are added according to established validation and consensus rules. This distributed structure, together with cryptographic mechanisms, helps make the blockchain resilient to later attempts to alter the ledger. Close booktiger's Diary [转载]可不能“随手一标”！ Posted by booktiger on 17 October 2026 in Chinese (China) (‪中文(中国大陆)‬) . 可不能“随手一标”！ 来源：国家安全部 2026年10月17日07:03 北京 https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/Xri2QFc-6VPpZ6QLBaqjgw 一张看似普通的网络地图，一个出于“兴趣”的随手标注，竟可能危害国家秘密安全。近年来，随着地理信息技术的普及，“开放地图”平台逐渐走入公众视野，但其背后隐藏的国家安全风险却不容忽视。 一个“爱好”带来的麻烦 2021年，许某在社交媒体上被一张带有艺术风格的路网地图所吸引。出于好奇，他开始接触境外开放地图平台，并违法“翻墙”访问。许某凭借对居住地周边环境的了解，以及从互联网搜集的公开信息，开始在境外开放地图平台上标注各类地理信息，多次标注军队等涉密敏感单位的位置信息。国家安全机关发现许某违法行为后迅速采取行动，依法对其开展审查。面对审查，许某懊悔道：“我完全没想到，自己只是出于爱好做点标记，竟会触犯法律，威胁国家安全。”国家安全机关向其宣讲了相关法律法规，讲明了其行为的危害性，并依法对其进行处理。许某表示已深刻认识到错误，并积极配合消除隐患。 随手一标，隐患巨大 “开放地图”一般指数据开源、可自由使用与编辑的地图项目，经常由全球志愿者共同创建、编辑并免费共享地理数据，在碳中和、城乡交通建设、灾害风险评估研究等方面具备相应应用价值。但如果在开放地图平台上标注我国涉密敏感地理信息，就有可能被不法分子利用，对我国家安全造成危害。不法分子无需动用复杂的技术手段，仅凭开放地图便能轻易获取我国涉密敏感单位的位置、规模等信息，并据此在军事基地等涉密敏感单位附近开展“黑飞”、偷拍、测绘等活动。境外间谍情报机关还可能结合其他渠道获取的信息进行多源数据交叉比对，拼凑成完整情报，甚至还可能对涉密单位工作人员以及周边居民、商户等人员开展针对性的渗透、拉拢和策反活动，对我国家安全构成严重威胁。 国家安全机关提示 《 中华人民共和国保守国家秘密法 》《 中华人民共和国测绘法 》《 公开地图内容表示规范 》等法律法规划出清晰底线：个人或者组织非法获取、持有、提供、利用属于国家秘密的地理信息的，将被依法追责。开放地图不是个人兴趣的“涂鸦板”，看似无心的标注可能触碰国家秘密“红线”。 ——绷紧“安全弦”。增强国家安全意识，不在地图平台标注任何涉及军事基地、涉密单位的地理信息。 ——把好“出口关”。不在社交平台发布涉密场所周边照片、视频，拍照前留意背景是否涉及敏感场所，不转发、不扩散任何标注有涉密地理信息的地图内容。 ——当好“守护者”。如发现在公开地图标注涉密地理信息等危害国家安全的可疑情况，请及时通过12339国家安全机关举报受理电话、网络举报受理平台（ www.12339.gov.cn ）、国家安全部微信公众号举报受理渠道或者直接向当地国家安全机关进行举报。 Discussion Leave a comment Log in to leave a comment

What are the three branches of government? The Constitution of the United States divides the federal government into three branches: Legislative Judicial Executive This ensures that no individual or group will have too much power. Legislative branch The legislative branch is made up of Congress : The U.S. Senate The U.S. House of Representatives It also includes special agencies and offices that provide support services to Congress. The legislative branch’s key roles include: Drafting proposed laws Confirming or rejecting presidential nominations for heads of federal agencies, federal judges, and the Supreme Court Surveying the budget Having the authority to declare war Judicial branch The judicial branch includes the Supreme Court and other federal courts. It evaluates laws by: Interpreting the meaning of laws Applying laws to individual cases Deciding if laws violate the Constitution Executive branch The president, the vice president, and the president's cabinet are the members of the executive branch. The executive branch’s key roles include: The president is the head of state, leader of the executive branch, and commander in chief of the United States armed forces. Close BrandonSimons_Aloe's Diary Mapping the Southern African grid from OpenStreetMap, and where the gaps are Posted by BrandonSimons_Aloe on 17 November 2026 in English . I run Aloe Energy, a small not-for-profit initiative working on energy access in Sub-Saharan Africa. We published a free interactive map of the Southern African Power Pool grid, and OpenStreetMap is its backbone, so I wanted to share how it was built and where OSM could use help. What we did. We took every OSM power line of 66 kV and above across the 12 SAPP countries (country extracts from November 2026). Where OSM had no line but an older public map did, we filled the gap from TANESCO (2015) and World Bank (2017) grid maps, but only for lines recorded as existing, with a known voltage, and more than about 3 km from any OSM line. A “Source and age” view on the map colors each line by where it comes from, so you can see exactly what is OSM and what is gap-fill. Where OSM is thin. Coverage is weakest in Tanzania, DR Congo and Angola. Those are the places where the map still leans on maps that are close to ten years old, and where new mapping would change the picture most. Substations named in national plans are often missing too. The map: https://aloeenergy.org/research/sapp-grid . pages.text: Bronze Age Akrotiri Is Greek's Pompeii Skip to main content History | November 3, 2026 Greece Has Its Own Pompeii, and the Ruins Tell a Captivating Story of a Sophisticated, Seafaring Bronze Age Society The Thera volcano, on modern-day Santorini, buried Akrotiri in ash in the 17th or 16th century B.C.E. The eruption was one of the largest in recorded history The ruins of Akrotiri, a Bronze Age settlement on what is now the Greek island of Santorini Westend61 via Getty Images The ruins of Akrotiri, a Bronze Age settlement on what is now the Greek island of Santorini Westend61 via Getty Images The earth rumbled for days. Inhabitants of the seafaring Bronze Age settlement of Akrotiri watched smoke plume from Thera , a long-dormant volcano on what is now the Greek island of Santorini . People gathered their belongings and safely stored the valuables they were forced to leave behind. Then they fled by boat to nearby islands. When these minor earthquakes and eruptions subsided, residents returned to Akrotiri, collecting materials for reconstruction and beginning the arduous process of repairing the damage . But the ground continued to tremble. As conditions worsened , they made the difficult decision to flee once more, hopeful that their homes would survive the coming devastation. When Thera erupted again, the explosion was so powerful that it destroyed Akrotiri, burying the settlement (and the island that shared the volcano’s name) in some 200 feet of ash and pumice stone. Brìghde Chaimbeul: Tiny Desk Concert October 23, 2026 5:00 AM ET Lars Gotrich Credit: Photo: Vanessa Castilllo/NPR A folk revival only goes so far as an artist's understanding — and adaptation — of tradition. What themes and melodies spoke to the past can easily echo into the present, but come alive through the personality of its interpreter. Satellite imagery, GIS, GPS, and drones all provide the ability to gather information about the scene. However, when a disaster happens indoors, none of those capabilities carry over. The available data becomes 2D, typically a blueprint if it exists, and does not include standpipes, shutoffs, alarm panels, or AEDs. These missing elements are necessary for a safe and timely response by first responders. Without indoor spatial intelligence, responders must make high stakes and high-risk decisions with incomplete information. However, many of these structures do not meet current building code requirements and require strategic upgrades. To address this vulnerability, NIST is actively developing best practices, design recommendations, and guidelines for utilizing building retrofit systems to improve the performance of existing structures. Beyond individual structures, it is critical to understand how different retrofit schemes and targets impact the community recovery. NIST is leading ongoing projects to quantify and measure the impact of various retrofit strategies at the community level.
